evidence.title: GitHub - ewgenius/ui: Generate custom CSS themes for shadcn/ui effortlessly using vibrant palettes from Radix Colors. · GitHub

name: shadcn-radix-colors
summary: Generates custom CSS themes for shadcn/ui from Radix Colors palettes, installable as prebuilt registry themes.
description: Web app that generates custom themes for shadcn/ui from vibrant Radix Colors palettes. Prebuilt themes are served in the shadcn registry format, so they can be installed with the shadcn CLI from urls like /themes/radix/[base-color]-[accent-color]-[primary-color]-[destructive-color].
contains: generates custom shadcn/ui themes from Radix Colors palettes
prebuilt themes installed with the shadcn CLI
